_note: Fair monster combat in the three story worlds (VORSCHLAEGE.md B1, B2, A10, A12; MECHANIK.md F1, M2). Read by src/hell/frost_moves.gd (the shared static rules) for src/hell/hell_monsters.gd (Krypta, Hoelle), the Frostgruft's themed mobs in src/hell/hell_game.gd and the frost moves.
_aim_lock: Share of a windup after which the aim stays where the hero stood then (swing, bolt, breath, homing, chain, dash, cleave; the Frostgruft's bullets and basic shots). 0.6 x 0.5 s leaves 0.2 s to step out of a blow.

tells._note: Windup (s) from the start of an act to its release, by act kind (hell_monsters.gd _run_act). An attack in the monster data may set its own "tell". swing 0.5 and bolt 0.45 per F1 (was 0.35 each); the rest as they were. leap: a slam with a leap (its flight). Frostgruft: dash and bolt also time the themed dashers, shooters and turrets (hell_game.gd _update_mobs).

boss_tells._note: A boss's own windups where they differ (F1: a boss's swing 0.45).

frost_min_windup._note: The Frostgruft's moves (combat_boss_moves.json windup) never wind up shorter than the other worlds' tells of their lane when they strike at once (bullets, dash, cone, spin, vortex); strikes and lobs warn on the floor after their windup.

tokens._note: Attack tokens (M2): at most max_melee monsters of a room in a melee windup or strike at once, max_ranged in a ranged one. Bosses and every monster in a living boss's room are never held back but count. A monster without a token tries again after retry s; a melee one circles the hero at keep px (plus its radius) at pace x its speed, the others keep their own movement.

hit_flash._note: A12: a hard white flash of the whole figure for the first time s after a hit (2-3 frames), at strength; a boss at boss (0: the feel's own softer flash only).

boss_telegraph._note: A10: a boss's area warning on the 3 px grid: the area filled red (fill_alpha + fill_ramp x charge), a charge filling it from the middle as the windup runs (charge_alpha + charge_ramp x charge), its front in the boss's element, a solid rim on a dark underlay that blinks to hot from blink_from of the windup at blink_hz.

boss_impact._note: A10: a boss's stomp (src/hell/hell_monsters.gd _boss_scar) leaves the crypt's lasting floor dent with dark cracks (crack_reach x its radius, crack_branches lines), dust creeping over the floor (dust bits within dust_reach x its radius) and rubble chunks; a cleave raises dust every line_dust_every px of its split. glow_cracks, floor_flash, puffs and chips make the impact itself strong (nacharbeit L2). Lengths in world px, speeds in world px/s, times in s, sizes in crypt px (2 crypt px = one 3 px art pixel).

glow_cracks._note: Thick branching cracks on the 3 px grid (_glow_cracks, _draw_glow_crack): branches lines run out to reach x the stomp radius (angle jitter rad at the start), within run s from the impact to the tips, in straight pieces of segment cells each kinked up to jag rad off a heading that drifts up to turn rad a piece; a cell forks with chance fork (fork_turn rad aside, at most depth forks deep); 3 cells wide while u (0 at the impact, 1 at a tip) is below wide[0], 2 below wide[1], then 1, a fork one narrower; the core line glows core heat over its sides. A cell's heat starts at heat[0] - heat[1] x u (the core line core more, its sides half that less) and falls by 1 every cool s; ramp[element] (default: fire and the hell) gives its colour from hot (1) to dark (0). edge: the dark lip round the crack (edge_alpha). time: the crack's life (it fades in the last quarter; the lasting dent stays).

floor_flash._note: A short flash over the floor (_floor_flash, _draw_floor_flash): an ellipse of reach x the stomp radius, squashed by squash like the floor, white at its middle through the element's light, its rim dithered, opening out a little while it fades over time s from alpha. It also lights the room for that moment (src/hero/story_glow.gd).

puffs._note: Chunky dust puffs (_dust_puffs): count puffs round the impact on a ring of ring x the stomp radius, each bits dust blocks of size crypt px in colors, thrown out at speed, each block up to spread px off the puff and spread px/s off its speed so it swells, slowed by drag (1/s) so the puff billows out and stops, fading over life s; grit bits of each puff fall and settle as grit on the floor.

chips._note: Stone chips (_stone_chips): count chips of size crypt px in colors, thrown out at speed and up at lift (world px/s), slowed by drag (1/s), arcing, bouncing off the floor and the walls and lying as grit after life s.

hero_xray._note: A3: the hero hidden behind an enemy standing in front of him (src/hero/story_hero.gd draw_cover, src/rig/rig_renderer.gd draw_xray): where an enemy's body covers his figure, his own silhouette is drawn over it in fill at fill_alpha, with a one art px rim in rim at rim_alpha round it, on his pixel grid, in every story world. ring: also the old light and dark ring round his whole figure (story_hero.gd OUTLINE cover_inner / cover_outer). A world's theme "outline" keys xray_fill, xray_fill_alpha, xray_rim, xray_rim_alpha override these.
